description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for evaluation-related API endpoints, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and managing evaluation versions, with error handling and external service calls.

methods.name: createEvaluation
methods.description: Handles creation of a new evaluation, extracting organization and workspace IDs from the request, constructing base URL, and calling the evaluations service.

methods.name: runAgain
methods.description: Triggers re-execution of an evaluation by ID, with organization and workspace context.

methods.name: getEvaluation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific evaluation by ID within the current workspace.

methods.name: deleteEvaluation
methods.description: Deletes an evaluation by ID within the current workspace.

methods.name: getAllEvaluations
methods.description: Fetches all evaluations with pagination within the current workspace.

methods.name: isOutdated
methods.description: Checks if a specific evaluation is outdated.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves different versions of an evaluation by ID.

methods.name: patchDeleteEvaluations
methods.description: Deletes multiple evaluations or all versions based on request body parameters.
